summary.text: David Tikoian is a Democratic state senator from Rhode Island who has represented District 22 since 2023 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: David Tikoian lives in Smithfield, graduated from Smithfield High School in 1986, and earned an associate degree from the Community College of Rhode Island in 1988 and a B.S. in business administration from Bryant University in 1990.
He graduated from the Rhode Island State Police Academy in 1992.

Tikoian's career included service with the State Police, rising to the rank of major and chief administrative officer, followed by a period as chief of the North Providence Police Department and work as director of transmission and distribution and deputy general manager for the Providence Water Supply Board.
He served on the Smithfield Town Council from 2020 to 2022, and took office in the State Senate on January 3, 2023, succeeding Steve Archambault.
